Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0

InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
compiler.clang++:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin

benchmark_method: Five sequential runs per binary per workload, alternating order; normal clocks; posix_spawn and per-child wait4; warm filesystem caches, no explicit warmup; raw outputs compared on every pair.
phase: Combined first and second optimization passes

regression.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

workloads.name: chisq-2-alleles
workloads.description: 200 sites, 96 samples, 15-site LD window, 2 alleles per site.

workloads.name: chisq-6-alleles
workloads.description: 200 sites, 96 samples, 15-site LD window, 6 alleles per site.

workloads.name: exclude-positions-overlap
workloads.description: 10000 deletion records, REF length 3000, final-base hits in 10000 target positions.

workloads.name: fst-2-alleles
workloads.description: 6000 sites, 128 samples, four populations, 2 alleles per site.

workloads.name: fst-64-alleles
workloads.description: 6000 sites, 128 samples, four populations, 64 alleles per site.

workloads.name: positions-overlap
workloads.description: 10000 deletion records, REF length 3000, final-base hits in 10000 target positions.

workloads.name: random-sample-marking
workloads.description: 50000 samples, 25000 retained; measures membership marking, with selection-independent output.

genotype_pair_index.formula: a*A - a*(a+1)/2 + b, a=min(first,second), b=max(first,second); return 0 for out-of-range alleles or index > INT_MAX
genotype_pair_index.limitations: Model check; no compiled helper execution. A=128 is included at helper level, not asserted to survive the existing CLI signed-int8 allele-count temporary format.
genotype_pair_index.method: Independent Python model: enumerate original upper-triangle map and compare both ordered genotype orientations against the production closed formula.

histogram_baseline_checks.assertions: All exit codes are zero; emitted minimum/maximum length bins match the declared span for every new case.

limitations: Finite regression corpus on macOS arm64 with Apple Clang 21; not a proof for every input, compiler or platform.
PCA/LAPACK disabled; Perl code unchanged and outside this differential matrix.
Fixed clocks control elapsed-time diagnostics and the original random seed, with no output normalization. Normal-clock benchmarks compare results and separately report raw diagnostic differences.
Synthetic algorithm workloads expose scaling bottlenecks. They are not production speed claims; short timings include process startup and should not be extrapolated.
Peak RSS includes code, libraries, allocator behavior and stack. Small page-sized increases are reported; no universal zero-RAM-increase guarantee.
In-place histogram sorting uses logarithmic stack space. Relatedness retains two quadratic count matrices.
Baseline undefined behavior for other unsupported/malformed inputs and optional features is not repaired by these performance changes.
